info.title: MentalBridge Community direct chat API
info.description: Implemented Community direct/group chat, current signed Realtime projections, presence peers and scoped notification authorization. Community owns all content and permission truth.

servers.description: Target gateway only; planned operations are not deployed.

get.description: Missing preferences return APPROVAL_REQUIRED, all visibility flags false and invisible false, version 0. No implicit opt-in.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

put.description: Complete replacement. Existing accepted conversations stay active; pending requests do not auto-accept. Revoke visibility immediately.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

post.description: Reuses the unique unordered profile pair. ANYONE creates an ACTIVE conversation; APPROVAL_REQUIRED creates a text-free request. Decline/block tombstones prevent repeated solicitation. No account-id or anonymous-author lookup.

201.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

post.description: Recipient only. ACCEPT returns ACTIVE; DECLINE/BLOCK returns 204, never a conversation. Repeated same terminal decision is a no-op; conflicting terminal decision is 409.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

204.description: Request declined or blocked; no content or conversation disclosed.

get.description: Viewer-safe conversations only. Sort by latest eligible message (or eligible relationship creation), never global hidden activity; no global message count, timestamp or sequence-derived watermark. Management version changes only for authorized relationship/group management, not messages/read cursors.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

get.description: Current viewer-safe conversation and its relationship/group management version. Not a message sequence or outbox revision. Use this read before another group command after a 204; self-leavers/removed viewers receive TARGET_UNAVAILABLE.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

get.description: Only current eligible participants; current-epoch group history only. Filter blocked/ineligible messages before pagination/counting. Return items in ascending private server sequence; never expose that sequence or gaps. nextCursor is an authenticated opaque, non-sequence-encoded continuation bound to actor, conversation, direction, membership and visibility epoch. Hidden traffic cannot alter visible items, continuation availability/meaning or reveal remaining counts; token bytes may vary due to nonce/signing. A stale visibility cursor is rejected generically as TARGET_UNAVAILABLE; restart an authorized read. No new eligible results means no nextCursor. Never disclose messages before join or prior rejoin epochs.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

post.description: Community transaction commits before 201. Dedupe (sender, conversationId, clientMessageId); retry same content returns same message, changed content is 409. Never implies recipient delivery/read/online.

201.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

put.description: Resolve lastReadMessageId only if currently visible to this actor in this conversation and membership epoch. Atomically advance the private server sequence watermark by max(previous, resolved), never beyond eligible history; duplicate/out-of-order acknowledgements cannot decrease it or add unread. Return a currently eligible message reference or null, not a numeric counter. Unknown/cross-conversation/blocked/prior-epoch targets uniformly TARGET_UNAVAILABLE. Private unread persists with shared receipts off.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

201.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

delete.description: OWNER only. Archive stops new sends/invites and revokes pending invitations; current members may read retained eligible history.

204.description: Committed; no body and no ETag. Do not reuse or increment the previous group version. A still-authorized member must GET getConversation for the fresh group management version before another versioned command; a self-leaver/removed actor has no further read or management entitlement.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

post.description: If-Match binds the current group management revision, not an invitation revision. The success ETag is the current group management revision; Invitation.version is the separate invitation revision used only for its decision.

201.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

post.description: Invitee only. ACCEPT atomically revalidates inviter role, membership cap, blocks, suspension and group ACTIVE state before joining. DECLINE is 204. Invitation alone grants no history/member list/presence. If-Match is the invitation revision, not the group revision. ACCEPT returns the current Group management version/ETag; DECLINE 204 has no body/ETag and grants no group read. Never reuse the invitation version for group commands.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

put.description: OWNER only; ADMIN/MEMBER transition for current non-owner member. No client-created owner role.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

delete.description: OWNER may remove any non-owner; ADMIN may remove MEMBER only. Self-leave uses this path with own profile; OWNER must transfer ownership or archive first. Removal/leave revokes history, socket, unread, presence and receipt access immediately.

204.description: Committed; no body and no ETag. Do not reuse or increment the previous group version. A still-authorized member must GET getConversation for the fresh group management version before another versioned command; a self-leaver/removed actor has no further read or management entitlement.

post.description: OWNER only; transfer atomically to active current ADMIN; former owner becomes ADMIN. Exactly one owner; concurrent transfer/leave fails 409.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

post.description: Reporter must currently be allowed to read exact message. Capture only reported message; no full transcript, unrelated people or automatic crisis intervention.

201.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

post.description: Community verifies authenticated service and signed short-lived USER delegation with exact audience/subject/action. Raw X-User/actor headers are not trusted. This boolean decision supports current subscribe/ephemeral visibility checks only; it is never a reusable permission grant or a way to fetch message content. Message fanout must use readCommunityMessageProjection for the exact message and viewer. MB-689 implements SUBSCRIBE only; ephemeral actions remain MB-690 and are rejected.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

post.summary: Read one currently authorized message for an exact delegated viewer
post.description: One read-only projection per exact conversation/message/viewer under RealtimeMessageReadDelegation. In the same consistent owner read, validate trusted service signature, audience/scope/expiry and target binding, resolve the signed USER subject, check current account/relationship/block/membership epoch/revocation and message visibility, then return only that Message. Never authorize separately then fetch content with a reusable boolean grant. Repeat the read for every recipient and replay; Realtime must discard queued projections on revocation, reauthorize immediately before fanout and must not retain a positive grant or raw content cache. Any known revocation wins over a queued send. A guessed/wrong-conversation/inaccessible message, blocked viewer, removed member, outsider or prior-epoch target is uniformly 404 TARGET_UNAVAILABLE. Invalid signed identity/audience is 401; wrong service/scope is 403; claims/body target mismatch is 404; unknown body identity selectors are 400. Owner dependency failure is 503 and never returns stale content. No Idempotency-Key on this read.

200.description: Fresh current-viewer Message only; no independent permission grant. Never cache.

Cache-Control.description: Private projection must not be cached.

post.description: Signed realtime-service delegation with audience community-service and scope community:session:authorize, lifetime at most 30s. Resolve current active USER and unrestricted Community profile; no unsigned actor selectors.

200.description: Current authorized owner projection; never cache.

post.description: Signed scope community:replay:project bound to the exact conversation and viewer. cursor=null establishes the current tail and returns no message IDs. Otherwise return up to 50 currently eligible message IDs in private ascending order, an opaque authenticated viewer/membership/visibility cursor, hasMore and absolute private ReadResult. Filter before pagination. The cursor never advances because of hidden traffic. It is an ephemeral live-delivery watermark, not a permission grant. Exact message content must be fetched separately for every recipient immediately before emit. Stale epochs return TARGET_UNAVAILABLE; establish a fresh tail and repair via public REST history without rebroadcasting old messages. No sequence is public.

200.description: Current authorized owner projection; never cache.

post.summary: Project currently authorized Community presence peers
post.description: Read-only, conversation-bound community:presence:project delegation. Community checks current USER eligibility, accepted direct relationship or current group membership, bilateral blocks/restrictions, subject presence opt-in and invisible mode before returning only eligible other current peers. Hidden subjects produce no row or denial reason. subjectRoutingReference is private Realtime-only routing, never a client field, cached grant, last-seen or durable presence fact. Reauthorize every fanout, including after Redis reads; no stale permission fallback. Wrong actor/scope is 403, signed target mismatch or inaccessible conversation 404, dependency uncertainty 503. Unknown body identity selectors are 400. No Idempotency-Key.

200.description: Current authorized other peers only; no-store. Empty peers reveals no hidden subject identity.

post.description: Read-only Content service scope community:notification:authorize. RS256 service JWT: issuer/subject content-notification-service, audience community-service, dedicated kid, jti UUID, iat <= now < exp <= iat + 30s. Exact stored target, actor, recipient, kind and conversation are verified against current Identity eligibility and local blocks, membership epoch and lifecycle. Request/invitation authorization does not grant transcript access. No content returned or cached permission grant. Target mismatch, denied, revoked and expired are uniform 404; dependency uncertainty is retryable 503. No Idempotency-Key.

200.description: Authoritative owner result; no optimistic success.

BearerAuth.description: Identity-issued USER token; server derives Community identity.

RealtimeDelegation.description: Authenticated service plus signed short-lived end-user delegation with exact audience/subject/scope; never browser-supplied routing identity.

NotificationServiceAuth.description: Content service credential scoped only to notification authorization.

RealtimeMessageReadDelegation.description: Realtime-only signed service + end-viewer delegation; MessageReadDelegationClaims is normative. audience community-service, scope community:message:project, exact conversationId/messageId, maximum 30s lifetime. USER BearerAuth and generic service credentials are insufficient. No cached authorization result is a grant.

version.description: Group management revision, distinct from private message ordering/outbox revision. Used by group If-Match.
Public relationship/group management revision only; never the private message sequence or outbox aggregateVersion. Sending/reading messages, including hidden traffic, does not advance this revision.
Public relationship/group management revision only; never the private message sequence or outbox aggregateVersion. Sending/reading messages, including hidden traffic, does not advance this revision.

Conversation.description: Viewer-authorized projection. No global or last-visible sequence watermark. unreadCount counts only eligible non-self messages in the current membership/visibility epoch; hidden traffic cannot change this DTO or its list position.

Message.description: Authorized message identity/content only. Conversation-global ordering remains private; IDs are random opaque UUIDs, never sequence-encoded IDs. REST page order is authoritative; a socket event alone does not define transcript order.

ReadCursor.description: Exact currently visible message in this conversation/current membership epoch. Community resolves its private sequence and atomically advances max(previous, resolved); no client-supplied sequence. Ineligible target is TARGET_UNAVAILABLE.

ReadResult.description: Last currently eligible read message reference, or null when none is visible. Private monotonic watermark is not disclosed; visibility changes may alter this safe reference without decreasing private state.

MessageReadDelegationClaims.description: Decoded signed JWT claims, never a JSON request body. Community verifies a trusted Realtime signature/algorithm/key, issuer, actor service, exact audience/scope, active USER subject, 0 < exp-iat <= 30 seconds and iat <= now < exp. Exact target claims must match the request and owned message. No unsigned identity headers or client-minted delegation. Shape validation alone is not authentication.

TargetUnavailable.description: Unknown and inaccessible targets are indistinguishable.

Conflict.description: Version, idempotency, lifecycle or member-cap conflict.

RateLimited.description: Bounded rate limit; retry only after Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a retry may be attempted.

DependencyUnavailable.description: Authoritative dependency unavailable; no allowed/success fallback.
